headline.text: Two *milk-chocolate chunks* found in L3 ML4 depositor 1 during changeover; sweco lid at L2 ML3 fell to floor during cleaning.

summary: Three food-safety events across two plants: foreign material in L3 equipment, floor-contact at L2, and a pest sighting at L1. L1 S2 has 4 pallets on hold for lot-code rework; L2 ML3 shut down with all product on hold pending level-4 clean.

holds.title: ML3 full line hold — all chocolate and FG
holds.summary: Out of abundance of caution, ML3 shut down; all chocolate removed from line and placed on hold; level-4 clean, ATP, and oil flush ordered.
holds.status: Hold active; level-4 clean in progress, quantities to be emailed.

holds.title: Lot-code error on S2 M7 — 4 pallets held for rework
holds.summary: Incorrect character entered in lot code during font adjustment; QA had not yet approved; production will rework by reprinting correct code on affected pouches.
holds.status: On hold pending rework by reprinting.

food_safety.title: Two milk-chocolate chunks in ML4 depositor 1
food_safety.summary: Two large chunks of milk chocolate discovered inside depositor 1 during white-chocolate changeover; origin unknown; no material believed missing from equipment.
food_safety.status: Chunks removed; investigation ongoing into source.

food_safety.title: Bat in production area
food_safety.summary: Bat observed flying in production area; supervisor caught it and released outside; no product contact reported.
food_safety.status: Resolved — bat removed; reminder issued to keep all doors closed.

food_safety.title: ML3 sweco lid dropped to floor during cleaning
food_safety.summary: Sweco lid was in sink for cleaning; EE pulled hose from same sink, lid came out with hose and fell to floor; lid requires re-clean before reinstallation.
food_safety.status: Lid removed from service; re-cleaning required before use.

food_safety.title: Damaged gasket found on ML4 north sweco
food_safety.summary: During installation of north sweco after cleaning, gasket discovered damaged; sweco taken out of service until gasket replaced.
food_safety.status: Sweco removed from service; gasket replacement in progress.

quality.title: S3 MM4 pouch defects — wrinkled, dirty, open, excess silvering
quality.summary: MM4 bags showing multiple quality defects: wrinkled, dirty, open pouches, and excess silvering at seal (spec allows up to 3 mm); line supervisor and operator notified to adjust.

quality.title: ML4 milk streaks in white chocolate during changeover
quality.summary: Milk chocolate visible in white-chocolate push at south depositors; QA approved running with 100% inspection at demolding; any bars with visible streaks scrapped; after 350 lb through system, no streaks observed.
quality.status: Running with QA inspection; no streaks observed after initial push.

quality.title: S2 underweight pieces flagged
quality.summary: QA observed underweight pieces; supervisor and operator informed to make adjustments to return to target weight.
quality.status: Adjustments made; weights returned to spec.

quality.title: S3 damaged pouches from vendor
quality.summary: Vendor-supplied pouches not cut correctly; causing operational issues; pictures sent to IPS for vendor follow-up.
quality.status: Vendor contacted with photos; awaiting response.

sanitation.title: Carts stacked with wheels off floor — re-clean required
sanitation.summary: Carts found stacked with wheels not on floor; QA flagged that carts must be recleaned and sanitized before use.
sanitation.status: Open — carts pulled from service pending re-clean.

sanitation.title: S2 caramel hopper pistons clogged
sanitation.summary: Four pistons in caramel hopper clogged; line stopped to clean; all pistons working normally after unblocking.
sanitation.status: Resolved — all pistons working after cleaning.

sanitation.title: S3 MM5 tapper rod clogged with product buildup
sanitation.summary: MM5 tapping rod not moving up and down; large buildup of chocolate and caramel found; maintenance cleaned buildup, tapping restored.
sanitation.status: Resolved — buildup cleaned, tapping working normally.

sanitation.title: S2 new Tunnel 2 belt cleaning verification passed
sanitation.summary: Production completed three cleanings of new Tunnel 2 belt during first shift; QA performed ATP testing at five points; all results passed.
sanitation.status: Passed — belt cleared for production use.

opportunities.text: Review door-closure discipline and pest-exclusion training — based on bat entry into production area on second shift.
Add MM5 tapper-rod cleaning to S3 preventive maintenance schedule — based on today's large buildup of chocolate and caramel preventing tapper movement.
Review sink and hose layout in ML3 cleaning area to prevent equipment falling to floor — based on sweco lid dropping when hose was pulled from shared sink.
Consider adding depositor-area inspection to ML4 changeover checklist — based on today's discovery of two milk-chocolate chunks inside depositor 1 with unknown origin.
